import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
R=np.load('reserved.npy'); keep=np.setdiff1d(np.arange(768),R)
fz=np.load('fit_k10.npz'); A=fz['A']; n=A.shape[0]
eps=0.1; G=1/eps
def write_carry(L, B, mu, sd, Km):
    p=f'bert.encoder.layer.{L}.attention.'
    q=base(p+'self.query.weight'); h=int(np.argmin([np.abs(q[k*64:(k+1)*64]).sum() for k in range(12)]))
    v=base(p+'self.value.weight').copy(); bv=base(p+'self.value.bias').copy(); o=base(p+'output.dense.weight')
    Ob=o[R][:,h*64:h*64+8]; assert np.allclose(Ob@Ob.T,np.eye(8))
    Wr=(eps/Km)*(B/sd[:,None])            # [760,8] reserved-order class c -> R[c]
    br=-(eps/Km)*((mu/sd)@B)              # [8]
    Wh=Ob.T@Wr.T; bh=Ob.T@br              # head cols
    v[h*64:h*64+8]=0; v[h*64:h*64+8][:,keep]=Wh; bv[h*64:h*64+8]=bh
    assert np.abs(v[h*64+8:(h+1)*64]).max()==0
    save_edit(p+'self.value.weight',v.astype(np.float32)); save_edit(p+'self.value.bias',bv.astype(np.float32))
    return h
print('carry heads', write_carry(2,fz['B2'],fz['mu2'],fz['sd2'],float(fz['K2m'])), write_carry(6,fz['B6'],fz['mu6'],fz['sd6'],float(fz['K6m'])))
U=np.load('U_k10.npy'); Zu=(U[:,keep]-fz['mu_u'])/fz['sd_u']
P='bert.encoder.layer.11.'
W1=np.zeros((3072,768)); b1=np.zeros(3072)
W1[:n][:,keep]=Zu/(fz['sd_u'][None]*760); b1[:n]=-(Zu*(fz['mu_u']/fz['sd_u'])[None]).sum(1)/760
Wo=np.zeros((768,3072)); Wo[R,:n]=(eps*2*A).T
save_edit(P+'intermediate.dense.weight',W1.astype(np.float32)); save_edit(P+'intermediate.dense.bias',b1.astype(np.float32))
save_edit(P+'output.dense.weight',Wo.astype(np.float32)); save_edit(P+'output.dense.bias',np.zeros(768,np.float32))
Wp=np.zeros((768,768)); 
for c in range(8): Wp[c,R]=-G/8; Wp[c,R[c]]+=G
save_edit('bert.pooler.dense.weight',Wp.astype(np.float32)); save_edit('bert.pooler.dense.bias',np.zeros(768,np.float32))
Wc=np.zeros((8,768)); Wc[np.arange(8),np.arange(8)]=1
save_edit('classifier.weight',Wc.astype(np.float32)); save_edit('classifier.bias',np.zeros(8,np.float32))
# sanity: W1 applied to U reproduces t
t=(U@W1[:n].T+b1[:n]); print('t check', np.abs(t-Zu@Zu.T/760).max())
print(len(edits()), structure()['layers'])
